<h1 id="propcache---简化属性缓存提升性能">propcache - 简化属性缓存，提升性能</h1>
<h2 id="一什么是propcache">一、什么是propcache？</h2>
<p><strong>propcache</strong> 是一个用于简化 Python 对象属性缓存的装饰器库。<br>
它可以帮助你：</p>
<ul>
<li>自动缓存计算量大的属性值，避免重复计算。</li>
<li>提高应用程序的性能和响应速度。</li>
<li>编写更简洁、更易于维护的代码。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="二应用场景">二、应用场景</h2>
<p><strong>propcache</strong> 广泛应用于以下实际场景：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>场景1</strong>: 计算量大的属性值，例如从数据库查询或进行复杂计算的结果，在多次访问时无需重复计算。</li>
<li><strong>场景2</strong>: 配置文件或配置对象中的属性值，如果这些值不经常变动，可以缓存起来。</li>
<li><strong>场景3</strong>: 外部API调用的结果，当API调用成本较高时，可以缓存结果以减少调用次数。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="三如何安装">三、如何安装</h2>
<ol>
<li>使用 pip 安装</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-bash">pip install propcache

# 如果安装慢的话，推荐使用国内镜像源
pip install propcache -i https://www.python64.cn/pypi/simple/
</code></pre>
<ol start="2">
<li>使用 <a href="https://www.min2k.com/tools/python-run/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">PythonRun</a> 在线运行代码（无需本地安装）</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="四示例代码">四、示例代码</h2>
<p>演示如何使用 <code>@cached_property</code> 装饰器缓存一个计算量大的属性。</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">from propcache import cached_property
import time

class SensorData:
    def __init__(self, data_source):
        self.data_source = data_source
        self._is_initialized = False # 用于判断是否第一次访问

    @cached_property
    def processed_data(self):
        # 模拟一个耗时的数据处理过程
        print("Processing raw data now...")
        time.sleep(1) # 模拟1秒的计算时间
        
        # 简单的条件判断示例
        if self.data_source == "realtime":
            result = "Realtime data processed: " + "sensor_value_A"
        else:
            result = "Historical data processed: " + "sensor_value_B"
        
        self._is_initialized = True # 标记为已初始化
        return result

    def get_status(self):
        if self._is_initialized:
            return "Data has been processed at least once."
        else:
            return "Data not yet processed for the first time."

# 第一次创建对象并访问属性
sensor1 = SensorData("realtime")
print(f"Status before first access: {sensor1.get_status()}")
print(sensor1.processed_data) # 第一次访问，会执行耗时计算
print(f"Status after first access: {sensor1.get_status()}")
print(sensor1.processed_data) # 第二次访问，直接返回缓存值，不会重新计算

print("-" * 30)

# 第二次创建对象并访问属性，模拟不同的数据源
sensor2 = SensorData("historical")
print(f"Status before first access: {sensor2.get_status()}")
print(sensor2.processed_data) # 第一次访问，会执行耗时计算
print(f"Status after first access: {sensor2.get_status()}")
print(sensor2.processed_data) # 第二次访问，直接返回缓存值
</code></pre>
<p>使用 <a href="https://www.min2k.com/tools/python-run/?code=from%20propcache%20import%20cached_property%0Aimport%20time%0A%0Aclass%20SensorData%3A%0A%20%20%20%20def%20__init__%28self%2C%20data_source%29%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20self.data_source%20%3D%20data_source%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20self._is_initialized%20%3D%20False%20%23%20%E7%94%A8%E4%BA%8E%E5%88%A4%E6%96%AD%E6%98%AF%E5%90%A6%E7%AC%AC%E4%B8%80%E6%AC%A1%E8%AE%BF%E9%97%AE%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%40cached_property%0A%20%20%20%20def%20processed_data%28self%29%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%23%20%E6%A8%A1%E6%8B%9F%E4%B8%80%E4%B8%AA%E8%80%97%E6%97%B6%E7%9A%84%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%E8%BF%87%E7%A8%8B%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20print%28%22Processing%20raw%20data%20now...%22%29%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20time.sleep%281%29%20%23%20%E6%A8%A1%E6%8B%9F1%E7%A7%92%E7%9A%84%E8%AE%A1%E7%AE%97%E6%97%B6%E9%97%B4%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%23%20%E7%AE%80%E5%8D%95%E7%9A%84%E6%9D%A1%E4%BB%B6%E5%88%A4%E6%96%AD%E7%A4%BA%E4%BE%8B%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20if%20self.data_source%20%3D%3D%20%22realtime%22%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20result%20%3D%20%22Realtime%20data%20processed%3A%20%22%20%2B%20%22sensor_value_A%22%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20else%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20result%20%3D%20%22Historical%20data%20processed%3A%20%22%20%2B%20%22sensor_value_B%22%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20self._is_initialized%20%3D%20True%20%23%20%E6%A0%87%E8%AE%B0%E4%B8%BA%E5%B7%B2%E5%88%9D%E5%A7%8B%E5%8C%96%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20return%20result%0A%0A%20%20%20%20def%20get_status%28self%29%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20if%20self._is_initialized%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20return%20%22Data%20has%20been%20processed%20at%20least%20once.%22%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20else%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20return%20%22Data%20not%20yet%20processed%20for%20the%20first%20time.%22%0A%0A%23%20%E7%AC%AC%E4%B8%80%E6%AC%A1%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E5%AF%B9%E8%B1%A1%E5%B9%B6%E8%AE%BF%E9%97%AE%E5%B1%9E%E6%80%A7%0Asensor1%20%3D%20SensorData%28%22realtime%22%29%0Aprint%28f%22Status%20before%20first%20access%3A%20%7Bsensor1.get_status%28%29%7D%22%29%0Aprint%28sensor1.processed_data%29%20%23%20%E7%AC%AC%E4%B8%80%E6%AC%A1%E8%AE%BF%E9%97%AE%EF%BC%8C%E4%BC%9A%E6%89%A7%E8%A1%8C%E8%80%97%E6%97%B6%E8%AE%A1%E7%AE%97%0Aprint%28f%22Status%20after%20first%20access%3A%20%7Bsensor1.get_status%28%29%7D%22%29%0Aprint%28sensor1.processed_data%29%20%23%20%E7%AC%AC%E4%BA%8C%E6%AC%A1%E8%AE%BF%E9%97%AE%EF%BC%8C%E7%9B%B4%E6%8E%A5%E8%BF%94%E5%9B%9E%E7%BC%93%E5%AD%98%E5%80%BC%EF%BC%8C%E4%B8%8D%E4%BC%9A%E9%87%8D%E6%96%B0%E8%AE%A1%E7%AE%97%0A%0Aprint%28%22-%22%20*%2030%29%0A%0A%23%20%E7%AC%AC%E4%BA%8C%E6%AC%A1%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E5%AF%B9%E8%B1%A1%E5%B9%B6%E8%AE%BF%E9%97%AE%E5%B1%9E%E6%80%A7%EF%BC%8C%E6%A8%A1%E6%8B%9F%E4%B8%8D%E5%90%8C%E7%9A%84%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E6%BA%90%0Asensor2%20%3D%20SensorData%28%22historical%22%29%0Aprint%28f%22Status%20before%20first%20access%3A%20%7Bsensor2.get_status%28%29%7D%22%29%0Aprint%28sensor2.processed_data%29%20%23%20%E7%AC%AC%E4%B8%80%E6%AC%A1%E8%AE%BF%E9%97%AE%EF%BC%8C%E4%BC%9A%E6%89%A7%E8%A1%8C%E8%80%97%E6%97%B6%E8%AE%A1%E7%AE%97%0Aprint%28f%22Status%20after%20first%20access%3A%20%7Bsensor2.get_status%28%29%7D%22%29%0Aprint%28sensor2.processed_data%29%20%23%20%E7%AC%AC%E4%BA%8C%E6%AC%A1%E8%AE%BF%E9%97%AE%EF%BC%8C%E7%9B%B4%E6%8E%A5%E8%BF%94%E5%9B%9E%E7%BC%93%E5%AD%98%E5%80%BC" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">PythonRun</a> 在线运行这段代码，结果如下：</p>

<p>使用 <a href="https://www.mermaid-online-editor.com/zh?code=flowchart%20TD%0A%20%20A%5B%22%E5%BC%80%E5%A7%8B%22%5D%20--%3E%20B%7B%22%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%20SensorData%20%E5%AF%B9%E8%B1%A1%3F%22%7D%0A%20%20B%20--%20%22%E6%98%AF%22%20--%3E%20C%5B%22%E5%88%9D%E5%A7%8B%E5%8C%96%20SensorData%3Cbr%2F%3E(data_source%2C_is_initialized%20%3D%20False)%22%5D%0A%20%20C%20--%3E%20D%5B%22%E8%AE%BF%E9%97%AE%20sensor.processed_data%22%5D%0A%20%20D%20--%3E%20E%7B%22%E5%B1%9E%E6%80%A7%20processed_data%3Cbr%2F%3E%E5%B7%B2%E7%BC%93%E5%AD%98%3F%22%7D%0A%20%20E%20--%20%22%E5%90%A6%22%20--%3E%20F%5B%22%E6%89%93%E5%8D%B0%20Processing%20raw%20data%20now...%22%5D%0A%20%20F%20--%3E%20G%5B%22%E6%A8%A1%E6%8B%9F%E8%80%97%E6%97%B6%20(time.sleep(1))%22%5D%0A%20%20G%20--%3E%20H%7B%22data_source%20%3D%3D%20'realtime'%3F%22%7D%0A%20%20H%20--%20%22%E6%98%AF%22%20--%3E%20I%5B%22result%20%3D%20'Realtime%20data...'%22%5D%0A%20%20H%20--%20%22%E5%90%A6%22%20--%3E%20J%5B%22result%20%3D%20'Historical%20data...'%22%5D%0A%20%20I%20--%3E%20K%5B%22%E8%AE%BE%E7%BD%AE%20_is_initialized%20%3D%20True%22%5D%0A%20%20J%20--%3E%20K%0A%20%20K%20--%3E%20L%5B%22%E8%BF%94%E5%9B%9E%20result%22%5D%0A%20%20E%20--%20%22%E6%98%AF%22%20--%3E%20L%5B%22%E7%9B%B4%E6%8E%A5%E8%BF%94%E5%9B%9E%E7%BC%93%E5%AD%98%E7%9A%84%20result%22%5D%0A%20%20L%20--%3E%20M%5B%22%E6%89%93%E5%8D%B0%20result%22%5D%0A%20%20M%20--%3E%20N%5B%22%E8%B0%83%E7%94%A8%20sensor.get_status()%22%5D%0A%20%20N%20--%3E%20O%7B%22_is_initialized%20%3D%3D%20True%3F%22%7D%0A%20%20O%20--%20%22%E6%98%AF%22%20--%3E%20P%5B%22%E8%BF%94%E5%9B%9E%20Data%20has%20been%20processed...%22%5D%0A%20%20O%20--%20%22%E5%90%A6%22%20--%3E%20Q%5B%22%E8%BF%94%E5%9B%9E%20Data%20not%20yet%20processed...%22%5D%0A%20%20P%20--%3E%20R%5B%22%E6%89%93%E5%8D%B0%E7%8A%B6%E6%80%81%22%5D%0A%20%20Q%20--%3E%20R%0A%20%20R%20--%3E%20S%7B%22%E8%BF%98%E6%9C%89%E6%9B%B4%E5%A4%9A%20SensorData%20%E5%AF%B9%E8%B1%A1%E6%88%96%E8%AE%BF%E9%97%AE%3F%22%7D%0A%20%20S%20--%20%22%E6%98%AF%22%20--%3E%20D%0A%20%20S%20--%20%22%E5%90%A6%22%
